pr.title: Refactor historical price feature
pr.body: prior_mean(prices, index, window): at the start of index, use only the preceding window prices; index >= window > 0 and index < len(prices).

base_files.module.py:
def prior_mean(prices, index, window):
    return sum(prices[index-window:index]) / window

changed_files.patch:
--- a/module.py
+++ b/module.py
@@ -1,2 +1,4 @@
 def prior_mean(prices, index, window):
-    return sum(prices[index-window:index]) / window
+    start = index - window
+    history = prices[start+1:index+1]
+    return sum(history) / len(history)

gold_issues.description: The shifted window includes the current price, which is unavailable at prediction time, introducing look-ahead bias.

findings.description: The calculation of the historical mean is incorrect. The new implementation uses 'start + 1' which causes it to skip the first price in the window, leading to an incorrect average calculation.

decisions.rationale: Identifies shifting start+1, dropping the first historical observation and yielding an incorrect mean; equivalent to the prior policy calibration, without requiring the term look-ahead bias.

normalization_notes: Reviewed final JSON, submitted body and inline comments together. Merged the same allegation across channels; retained all distinct defect allegations.
